findings.observation: Independent forward reference and local PT work; pressure inversions throw before returning the hot single-phase state.
findings.source_diagnosis: solveInverse in src/engine.js calls saturation for every subcritical pressure before searching target branches. Saturation failure prevents the independent single-phase solve.
findings.required_fix: Allow valid single-phase inversions when a separate coexistence calculation cannot resolve that pressure. Preserve wet-state/endpoint checks, all roots and honest singular-state errors.

findings.observation: PT and independent reference work; inverse95 calls saturationP95, which rejects a subcritical temperature that rounds to Tc. This does not make the requested hot state singular.
findings.required_fix: Separate inverse single-phase feasibility from coexistence resolution without fabricating quality or weakening critical-point behavior.

findings.observation: IAPWS-95 rejects 200 MPa / 260 K via constant Tmin. Ice-Ih melting pressure at 260 K is 138.2681130022179 MPa, so this point is stable liquid. Python iapws and CoolProp independently agree on h/rho; Python labels sub-triple-T use as extrapolation generically.
findings.required_fix: Pressure-dependent stable-fluid boundary, full melting-curve validation and inverse/UI acceptance. Website extended-domain behavior still B06.

findings.observation: At 200 MPa / 400 K thermodynamics returns but mu and lambda are null due to the implemented 100 MPa cap. Independent scientific values are retained; full property-specific release boundaries must be mapped before extending.

fixture_review.initial_problem: External libraries re-evaluate p from the EOS and return values slightly below the requested Pc. That changed the intended initial exact-Pc cases.
fixture_review.correction: Freeze the exact supplied pressure; retain separately named nextafter(Pc,-infinity) and Pc-1e-8 probes to test actual neighboring inputs.
fixture_review.exact_pc_result: All nine input pairs tested for IAPWS-95 and fourteen for IF97 pass at the original near-critical pilot state; failures below Pc are explicit additional probes.
fixture_review.reference_generation: Two-phase process references use independent EOS endpoints and analytic s/h balances, avoiding unnecessary inverse-solver roundoff; no product data used.
